name: Cube Reconstruction
description: Generate and verify opposite-face and possible-view questions from a colored or patterned cube net.
steps: Select a pattern and inspect its representative original
Record the intended inference, condition, closest foil and distinguishing evidence
Create six marked faces and render the net and cube in FreeCAD
Solve the displayed options and verify the final PNG
Check the declared inference and revise the named option or condition if needed
Review the visible evidence and publish the verified candidate
